caption: This ramen features a rich, savory broth with visible chili oil flecks. Toppings—chashu, soft-boiled egg, nori, and scallions—rest atop noodles in a glossy black bowl, set against warm wooden tones under soft, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Light wooden table surface with smooth texture and subtle grain patterns visible.
The chashu pork is a round, thinly sliced piece with pink and white marbling, showing a tender, slightly glistening surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular with slightly uneven edges and visible surface patterns.
The spicy broth is rich, amber-brown, glossy, and thick, clinging to noodles and garnishes in a curved, shallow bowl shape.
A halved boiled egg shows a firm white and vibrant yellow yolk, with a smooth surface and slight browning on the white.
Black ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, smooth curved rim, and subtle reflective highlights.
A red spoon with smooth, slightly glossy surface and curved handle, showing subtle wear near the tip.
